hints.title: Binary Search on Subpath Length
hints.text: The problem asks for the maximum length L such that a subpath of length L appears in all friends paths.

hints.title: Feasibility Search Interval
hints.text: binary search on the subpath length L in the range [1, min(len(path))].

hints.title: Double Rolling Hash Intersection
hints.text: for a candidate length L, use rolling hash (Rabin-Karp) with double hashing to collect subpath hashes for each friend, taking the intersection across all friends.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Double rolling hash (Rabin-Karp) verifies common candidate length L without hash collisions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Suffix tree construction across multiple large paths is memory intensive and prone to quadratic worst-case behaviors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on length L with double rolling hash takes O(M * N * log(min_len)) time with O(min_len) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize binary search on length combined with Rabin-Karp rolling hash and collision prevention.
